whoItsFor: Engineers, designers, and makers who already use an AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, or Grok) and want it to generate, check, and prepare 3D CAD parts for manufacturing.
useCases: Generate 3D models as STEP, GLB, STL, or 3MF files from text prompts
Run design-for-manufacturing checks and produce engineering drawings
Send designs to 3D printing, sheet metal, or CNC fabrication services
